sheets.name: Read me
rows: Laurito Capital / Mack Living: accommodation opportunities workbook v4 (built 2026-11-03, Europe/London). v4 adds BiP Intelligence evidence to v3.
Purpose: identify realistically pursuable UK leased and temporary accommodation routes, why each is attractive, what blocks action today, and the next step.

Start at Priority_Ranking. Edit weights and thresholds on Methodology (yellow cells). Edit ratings, gates, source tier and evidence dates on Opportunity_Scoring (yellow cells). Counterparty ratings live on Counterparty_Financials.

Scores: A = contract/access opportunity; B = financial strength of the signing entity; C = property fit to a requirement; D = property investment economics (GIY is gross, not NIY); E = evidence confidence.
Gates come first. FAIL = confirmed exclusion. UNKNOWN = Qualify (capped). Blank rating = unknown (never zero, never a pass). NA = not applicable.
The pursuit index prioritises research and outreach. It is not a probability, a credit approval or an investment recommendation.

Framework membership is not an awarded contract; a framework ceiling is not accessible revenue; public funding is not a government rent guarantee; a managing agent is not a tenant; parent strength is not a parent guarantee.

Every material fact is in Fact_Register with URL, snippet, publication date, date checked and status. Link checks are in Sources; integrity checks in Checks; test cases in Test_Cases; changes in Change_Log.

Starting point: the v2 values published at https://pgraham974.github.io/ecosystem-partners/#sheets (imported 2026-10-20). The original formula workbooks (.xlsx) were not available, so v2 formulas could not be inspected directly.
Sheets prefixed Orig_ are preserved v2 content (dashes normalised). Orig_Contacts holds named contacts: internal and private, do not share.

LICENSED DATA: BiP_Evidence and every fact citing app.bipintelligence.com or BiP spend come from BiP Intelligence (licensed). Internal use only: do not publish, share or copy BiP-derived content outside this workbook.

BiP distinctions: a framework award is not a call-off; a ceiling or estimated value is not spend; spend rows are actual payments for a sampled month only and do not by themselves show property intake.
